title: Watercolor & Glitter Procreate Brushes
author: Patishop Art
description:
Unlock your artistic potential with our collection of high-quality Procreate brushes, including easy watercolor, digital watercolor, and watercolor brushes. These painting brushes are carefully crafted to emulate the rich, fluid textures of traditional watercolor painting in a digital environment. With just a few strokes, you can effortlessly create stunning watercolor effects that bring your artwork to life.
Our Procreate watercolor brushes offer a seamless experience, allowing you to explore the world of watercolor painting with ease. Whether you’re a seasoned artist or just starting, these brushes are designed to enhance your creative process.
In addition to our watercolor collection, we also offer glitter brushes that add a touch of magic to your artwork. These brushes create shimmering, sparkling effects that can transform your illustrations. Our gold brushes, in particular, bring a touch of luxury and elegance to your designs, making them perfect for special projects.
Discover the versatility of Procreate with our texture-rich brushes designed for watercolor, glitter, and gold effects. Elevate your digital artistry and create captivating masterpieces with Procreate’s intuitive tools and our premium brush collection.
INCLUDED
4 watercolor brushes + blender | .BRUSHSET file
4 glitter blushes | .BRUSHSET file
watercolor paper for painting 4000×3000px | 300 DPI | .PROCREATE file
2 color palettes | .SWATCHES file
REQUIREMENTS:
* Procreate App
* Apple Pencil
* iPad Pro
INSTALLATION:
✅ Make sure your iOS is updated and you have the latest version of Procreate App: Procreate 5 and higher. The brushes only work in the Procreate app. They do not work in any other apps.
